question: In Slack: Invite Aisha Khan to the channel with 'incident' in its name, whose Topic mentions postmortems, and that hasn't been archived yet. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
No channel matches all three conditions — so I didn't invite anyone.

The only non-archived channel with "incident" in its name is **#incident-comms**, but its **Topic** is "Live incident chatter and status updates" — no mention of postmortems. (The postmortem mention is in its *Purpose*: "Coordinate postmortems and retro scheduling.")

If you meant #incident-comms (i.e., the postmortem reference in the Purpose counts), say the word and I'll invite Aisha Khan (aisha.khan) right away.
